description: Returns all accounts owned by the provided program Pubkey.

parameters.name: pubkey
parameters.description: The Pubkey of program encoded as base-58 string

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The configuration object with the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: commitment
sub_parameters.description: The level of commitment required for the query. The options include:

sub_parameters.name: finalized
sub_parameters.description: The node will query the most recent block confirmed by the supermajority of the cluster as having reached maximum lockout, meaning the cluster has recognized this block as finalized

sub_parameters.name: confirmed
sub_parameters.description: The node will query the most recent block that has been voted on by the supermajority of the cluster

sub_parameters.name: processed
sub_parameters.description: The node will query its most recent block. Note that the block may not be complete

sub_parameters.name: minContextSlot
sub_parameters.description: The minimum slot at which the request can be evaluated

sub_parameters.name: withContext
sub_parameters.description: Wraps the result in a RpcResponse JSON object

sub_parameters.name: filters
sub_parameters.description: Filter results using up to 4 filter objects. See Filtering

sub_parameters.name: dataSlice
sub_parameters.description: Request a slice of the account's data: length (): number of bytes to return. offset (): byte offset from which to start reading. Data slicing is only available for 'base58', 'base64', or 'base64+zstd' encodings.

sub_parameters.name: encoding
sub_parameters.description: (Default: binary) Encoding format for the returned account data. Explicitly setting this field is recommended to avoid size or performance issues. Valid options include 'base58', 'base64', 'binary', 'base64+zstd', and 'jsonParsed' (valid for certain native programs).

result.description: The result will be RpcResponse JSON object with the following fields:

result.pubkey.description: The public key of the node encoded as base-58 string

result.account.description: A JSON object with the following fields:

result.account.lamports.description: The number of lamports assigned to this account as u64 (64-bit unsigned integer)

result.account.owner.description: The base-58 encoded Pubkey of the program this account has been assigned to

result.account.data.description: Data associated with the account. Format depends on encoding parameter:

result.account.executable.description: A boolean indicating if the account contains a program (and is strictly read-only)

result.account.rentEpoch.description: The epoch at which this account will next owe rent, as u64 (64-bit unsigned integer)

result.account.space.description: The amount of storage space required to store the token account
